app.title: Tidefold light
app.descr:
Tidefold is a calm logic puzzle about reading the tide, pushing water, and crystallizing edges.

Key features:
- 16 handcrafted challenges with a rising insight curve
- Push water along the tide; clear an edge to turn the flow
- Local stamps and sequential unlocks
- English and Simplified Chinese
- Offline-friendly; progress saved on your device

No account required. Contact: crystalh@nazeri-2000.com
